756: func summarizeSprintStatus(status sprint.StatusSummary) string {
757: 	parts := make([]string, 0, len(status.Stages)+2)
758: 	for _, stage := range status.Stages {
759: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", stage.Stage, stage.Status))
760: 	}
761: 	execute := summarizeExecute(status.ExecuteState)
762: 	if execute.Available {
763: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("execute=%d/%d complete (%d failed, %d cancelled)", execute.Complete, execute.Total, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled))
764: 	} else {
765: 		parts = append(parts, "execute=not started")
766: 	}
767: 	if status.Review == nil {
768: 		parts = append(parts, "review=not started")
769: 	} else {
770: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("review=%s verdict=%s stale=%t", status.Review.Status, status.Review.Verdict, status.Review.Stale))
771: 	}
772: 	if status.Smoke == nil {
773: 		parts = append(parts, "smoke=not started")
774: 	} else {
775: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("smoke=%s verdict=%s stale=%t", status.Smoke.Status, status.Smoke.Verdict, status.Smoke.Stale))
776: 	}
777: 	parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", status.Verification.Assessment, status.Verification.NextAction))
778: 	return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
779: }

787: func failedOperation(r OperationResult, err error) (OperationResult, error) {
788: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
789: 		r.State = OperationCancelled
790: 	} else {
791: 		r.State = OperationFailed
792: 	}
793: 	cause := displaySafe(err.Error())
794: 	code, category, guidance := "internal.error", "internal", "Inspect durable state and retry after correcting the reported cause."
795: 	if smokeErr, ok := sprint.AsSmokeError(err); ok {
796: 		code, category, guidance = smokeErr.Code, smokeErr.Category, smokeErr.Guidance
797: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
798: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "smoke", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "process" || category == "timeout"}
799: 		return r, err
800: 	}
801: 	if qaErr, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
802: 		category = string(qaErr.Category)
803: 		code = "qa." + category
804: 		guidance = qaErr.Recovery
805: 		switch qaErr.Category {
806: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
807: 			category = "runtime"
808: 		case sprint.QAErrorConflict:
809: 			category = "concurrency"
810: 		default:
811: 			category = "validation"
812: 		}
813: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
814: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "qa", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable || qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorConflict}
815: 		return r, err
816: 	}
817: 	var projectRef project.RefError
818: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
819: 	switch {
820: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
821: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.cancelled", "cancellation", "Resume the operation when ready."
822: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported),
823: 		errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported),
824: 		errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef), len(r.Findings) > 0:
825: 		code, category, guidance = "validation.reference", "validation", "Complete or repair the reported governed evidence, inspect validation findings, and retry."
826: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict), errors.Is(err, ErrStaleOperation):
827: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.locked", "concurrency", "Inspect the active or stale study lock before retrying."
828: 	}
829: 	r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
830: 	r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "workflow.operation", Component: "app", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "runtime" || category == "concurrency"}
831: 	return r, err
832: }

834: func operationFailureMessage(category string) string {
835: 	switch category {
836: 	case "cancellation":
837: 		return "Operation cancelled."
838: 	case "validation":
839: 		return "Operation failed validation."
840: 	case "runtime", "process", "timeout":
841: 		return "Runtime operation failed."
842: 	case "concurrency":
843: 		return "Operation could not acquire mutation ownership."
844: 	default:
845: 		return "Operation failed."
846: 	}

854: func operationFirstNonEmpty(a, b string) string {

400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
505: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
508: 		}
509: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
510: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
511: 	case OperationQAStatus:
512: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
513: 		if err != nil {
514: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
515: 		}
516: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
517: 	case OperationQADryRun:
518: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
519: 			smoke, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
520: 			if err != nil {
521: 				return failedOperation(result, err)
522: 			}
523: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("smoke suite ready: %s %s", smoke.ScopeKind, smoke.Scope)
524: 			result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(smoke))
525: 			break
526: 		}
527: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
528: 		if err != nil {
529: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
530: 		}
531: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
532: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
533: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
534: 	case OperationQARecover:
535: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
538: 		}
539: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
540: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
541: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
542: 		if err != nil {
543: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
544: 		}
545: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
546: 	default:
547: 		if u.runner == nil {
548: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
549: 		}
550: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
551: 	}
552: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
553: 	return result, nil
554: }

574: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
575: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
576: 		if value == "" {
577: 			continue
578: 		}
579: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
580: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
581: 		}
582: 		for _, r := range value {

584: 				continue
585: 			}
586: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	return nil
590: }

699: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
700: 	hash := sha256.New()
701: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
702: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
703: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
704: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
705: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
706: 			continue
707: 		}
708: 		if err != nil {
709: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
710: 		}
711: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
712: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
713: 		}
714: 		if info.IsDir() {
715: 			var files []string
716: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
717: 				if walkErr != nil {
718: 					return walkErr
719: 				}
720: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
721: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
722: 				}
723: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
724: 					files = append(files, item)
725: 				}
726: 				return nil
727: 			}); err != nil {
728: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("scan governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
729: 			}
730: 			sort.Strings(files)
731: 			for _, item := range files {
732: 				itemRel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, item)
733: 				if err := hashOperationFile(hash, item, filepath.ToSlash(itemRel)); err != nil {
734: 					return "", err
735: 				}
736: 			}
737: 			continue
738: 		}
739: 		if err := hashOperationFile(hash, path, rel); err != nil {
740: 			return "", err
741: 		}
742: 	}
743: 	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
744: }
745: 
746: func hashOperationFile(hash interface{ Write([]byte) (int, error) }, path, rel string) error {
747: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
748: 	if err != nil {
749: 		return fmt.Errorf("read governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
750: 	}
751: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte("\x00" + rel + "\x00"))
752: 	_, _ = hash.Write(data)
753: 	return nil
754: }

756: func summarizeSprintStatus(status sprint.StatusSummary) string {
757: 	parts := make([]string, 0, len(status.Stages)+2)
758: 	for _, stage := range status.Stages {
759: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s=%s", stage.Stage, stage.Status))
760: 	}
761: 	execute := summarizeExecute(status.ExecuteState)
762: 	if execute.Available {
763: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("execute=%d/%d complete (%d failed, %d cancelled)", execute.Complete, execute.Total, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled))
764: 	} else {
765: 		parts = append(parts, "execute=not started")
766: 	}
767: 	if status.Review == nil {
768: 		parts = append(parts, "review=not started")
769: 	} else {
770: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("review=%s verdict=%s stale=%t", status.Review.Status, status.Review.Verdict, status.Review.Stale))
771: 	}
772: 	if status.Smoke == nil {
773: 		parts = append(parts, "smoke=not started")
774: 	} else {
775: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("smoke=%s verdict=%s stale=%t", status.Smoke.Status, status.Smoke.Verdict, status.Smoke.Stale))
776: 	}
777: 	parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", status.Verification.Assessment, status.Verification.NextAction))
778: 	return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
779: }

787: func failedOperation(r OperationResult, err error) (OperationResult, error) {
788: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
789: 		r.State = OperationCancelled
790: 	} else {
791: 		r.State = OperationFailed
792: 	}
793: 	cause := displaySafe(err.Error())
794: 	code, category, guidance := "internal.error", "internal", "Inspect durable state and retry after correcting the reported cause."
795: 	if smokeErr, ok := sprint.AsSmokeError(err); ok {
796: 		code, category, guidance = smokeErr.Code, smokeErr.Category, smokeErr.Guidance
797: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
798: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "smoke", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "process" || category == "timeout"}
799: 		return r, err
800: 	}
801: 	if qaErr, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
802: 		category = string(qaErr.Category)
803: 		code = "qa." + category
804: 		guidance = qaErr.Recovery
805: 		switch qaErr.Category {
806: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
807: 			category = "runtime"
808: 		case sprint.QAErrorConflict:
809: 			category = "concurrency"
810: 		default:
811: 			category = "validation"
812: 		}
813: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
814: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "qa", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable || qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorConflict}
815: 		return r, err
816: 	}
817: 	var projectRef project.RefError
818: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
819: 	switch {
820: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
821: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.cancelled", "cancellation", "Resume the operation when ready."
822: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported),
823: 		errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported),
824: 		errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef), len(r.Findings) > 0:
825: 		code, category, guidance = "validation.reference", "validation", "Complete or repair the reported governed evidence, inspect validation findings, and retry."
826: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict), errors.Is(err, ErrStaleOperation):
827: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.locked", "concurrency", "Inspect the active or stale study lock before retrying."
828: 	}
829: 	r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
830: 	r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "workflow.operation", Component: "app", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "runtime" || category == "concurrency"}
831: 	return r, err
832: }

834: func operationFailureMessage(category string) string {

836: 	case "cancellation":
837: 		return "Operation cancelled."
838: 	case "validation":

840: 	case "runtime", "process", "timeout":
841: 		return "Runtime operation failed."
842: 	case "concurrency":
843: 		return "Operation could not acquire mutation ownership."
844: 	default:
845: 		return "Operation failed."
846: 	}

860: func promptSprintStage(s sprint.Service, p, sp string, stage sprint.PlanningStage) (sprint.PromptPreview, error) {
861: 	switch stage {
862: 	case sprint.StageRequirements:

232: 		case <-owned.stop:

238: 				return

277: 		if appendErr != nil && runErr == nil {
278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}

283: 	close(owned.stop)

106: 	if err != nil && digest != "" && errors.Is(err, runcontrol.ErrConflict) {
107: 		existing, resolveErr := m.repository.ResolveOperationAlias(ctx, digest)
108: 		if resolveErr != nil {
109: 			return AcceptedOperation{}, errors.Join(err, resolveErr)
110: 		}
111: 		return AcceptedOperation{RunID: string(existing.RunID), Context: ctx, Existing: true, Lifecycle: string(existing.Lifecycle)}, nil
112: 	}
113: 	if err != nil {
114: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation acceptance: %w", err)
115: 	}
116: 	attempt, _, err := m.repository.Claim(ctx, runcontrol.Claim{RunID: snapshot.RunID, Owner: m.owner, Lease: runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration})
117: 	if err != nil {
118: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation owner claim: %w", err)
119: 	}
120: 	fence := runcontrol.Fence{RunID: snapshot.RunID, AttemptID: attempt.ID, OwnerID: m.owner.ID, FencingGeneration: attempt.FencingGeneration}
121: 	if _, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
122: 		Type: runcontrol.EventLifecycle, Lifecycle: runcontrol.LifecycleRunning,
123: 		Payload: map[string]string{"lifecycle": string(runcontrol.LifecycleRunning)},
124: 	}); err != nil {
125: 		terminalCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
126: 		_, _, _ = proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(terminalCtx, m.repository, fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: runcontrol.TerminalPersistenceLost, Reason: "operation start persistence failed", ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
127: 		cancel()
128: 		return AcceptedOperation{}, fmt.Errorf("persist confirmed operation start: %w", err)
129: 	}
130: 	operationCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(runcontrol.WithParentRun(ctx, snapshot.RunID))
131: 	operationCtx = context.WithValue(operationCtx, durableOperationContextKey{}, durableOperationOwnership{repository: m.repository, fence: fence})
132: 	owned := &ownedDurableOperation{fence: fence, cancel: cancel, stop: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{})}
133: 	m.mu.Lock()
134: 	m.owned[string(snapshot.RunID)] = owned
135: 	m.mu.Unlock()
136: 	go m.controlOperation(operationCtx, owned)
137: 	return AcceptedOperation{RunID: string(snapshot.RunID), Context: operationCtx, Lifecycle: string(runcontrol.LifecycleRunning)}, nil
138: }
139: 
140: func qaOwnershipFromContext(ctx context.Context) (sprint.QAWriterToken, func(sprint.QAWriterToken) error, error) {
141: 	ownership, ok := ctx.Value(durableOperationContextKey{}).(durableOperationOwnership)
142: 	if !ok || ownership.repository == nil {
143: 		return sprint.QAWriterToken{}, nil, errors.New("durable QA ownership is missing from the operation context")
144: 	}
145: 	token := sprint.QAWriterToken{RunID: string(ownership.fence.RunID), OperationalAttemptID: string(ownership.fence.AttemptID), FencingGeneration: ownership.fence.FencingGeneration}
146: 	fence := func(got sprint.QAWriterToken) error {
147: 		if got != token {
148: 			return runcontrol.ErrStaleFence
149: 		}
150: 		fenceCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 30*time.Second)
151: 		defer cancel()
152: 		_, err := ownership.repository.Heartbeat(fenceCtx, ownership.fence, runControlLease)
153: 		return err
154: 	}
155: 	return token, fence, nil
156: }
157: 
158: func (m *durableOperationManager) RecordOperationEvent(ctx context.Context, runID string, event OperationEvent) (bool, error) {
159: 	m.mu.Lock()
160: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
161: 	m.mu.Unlock()
162: 	if owned == nil {
163: 		return false, runcontrol.ErrNotFound
164: 	}
165: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
166: 	defer owned.eventMu.Unlock()
167: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
168: 	if event.State == OperationFailed {
169: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
170: 	}
171: 	key := string(eventType) + "\x00" + event.Stage + "\x00" + event.Task + "\x00" + event.PhaseState + "\x00" + event.SafeSummary + "\x00" + event.EventType + "\x00" + event.EventKind + "\x00" + event.Tool + "\x00" + event.Reason + "\x00" + event.Detail
172: 	now := time.Now().UTC()
173: 	elapsed := now.Sub(owned.progressAt)
174: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress && key == owned.progressKey && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < runcontrol.ProgressCoalesceWindow {
175: 		if owned.omitted == 0 {
176: 			owned.omittedFirst = now
177: 		}
178: 		owned.omitted++
179: 		owned.omittedLast = now
180: 		return false, nil
181: 	}
182: 	payload := map[string]string{
183: 		"state": string(event.State), "type": event.EventType,
184: 		"count": fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", event.Completed, event.Total),
185: 	}
186: 	for key, value := range map[string]string{
187: 		"phase_state": event.PhaseState, "summary": event.SafeSummary,
188: 		"tool_call_id": event.ToolCallID, "tool_status": event.ToolStatus,
189: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
190: 		"provider": event.Provider, "model": event.Model, "harness": event.Harness,
191: 	} {
192: 		if value != "" {
193: 			payload[key] = value
194: 		}
195: 	}
196: 	var omission *runcontrol.Omission
197: 	if event.Message != "" {
198: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "presentation message omitted", Count: 1}
199: 	}
200: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
201: 		if omission == nil {
202: 			omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced"}
203: 		}
204: 		omission.Count += owned.omitted
205: 		omission.FirstAt, omission.LastAt = &owned.omittedFirst, &owned.omittedLast
206: 		owned.omitted = 0
207: 	}
208: 	_, _, err := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{
209: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeOperation, Stage: event.Stage, Task: event.Task,
210: 		Kind: event.EventKind, Tool: event.Tool, Action: event.Action, Reason: event.Reason,
211: 		Detail: event.Detail, Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
212: 	})
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		owned.cancel()
215: 		return false, err
216: 	}
217: 	if eventType == runcontrol.EventProgress {
218: 		owned.progressKey, owned.progressAt = key, now
219: 	}
220: 	return true, nil
221: }
222: 
223: func (m *durableOperationManager) controlOperation(ctx context.Context, owned *ownedDurableOperation) {
224: 	defer close(owned.done)
225: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(runcontrol.OwnerTickInterval)
226: 	defer ticker.Stop()
227: 	lastHeartbeat, lastReconcile := time.Now(), time.Now()
228: 	for {
229: 		select {
230: 		case <-ctx.Done():
231: 			return
232: 		case <-owned.stop:
233: 			return
234: 		case now := <-ticker.C:
235: 			snapshot, err := m.repository.Snapshot(ctx, owned.fence.RunID)
236: 			if err != nil {
237: 				owned.cancel()
238: 				return
239: 			}
240: 			if snapshot.Cancellation.State == runcontrol.CancellationRequested {
241: 				if _, _, err := m.repository.AcknowledgeCancellation(ctx, owned.fence); err != nil {
242: 					owned.cancel()
243: 					return
244: 				}
245: 				owned.cancel()
246: 				return
247: 			}
248: 			if now.Sub(lastHeartbeat) >= runcontrol.HeartbeatInterval {
249: 				if _, err := m.repository.Heartbeat(ctx, owned.fence, runcontrol.OwnerLeaseDuration); err != nil {
250: 					owned.cancel()
251: 					return
252: 				}
253: 				lastHeartbeat = now
254: 			}
255: 			if now.Sub(lastReconcile) >= runcontrol.ReconciliationInterval {
256: 				if _, err := m.repository.Reconcile(ctx, runcontrol.NativeProcessProbe{}, runcontrol.ReconcileOptions{}); err != nil {
257: 					owned.cancel()
258: 					return
259: 				}
260: 				lastReconcile = now
261: 			}
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: }
265: 
266: func (m *durableOperationManager) FinishOperation(ctx context.Context, runID string, state OperationState, runErr error) error {
267: 	m.mu.Lock()
268: 	owned := m.owned[runID]
269: 	delete(m.owned, runID)
270: 	m.mu.Unlock()
271: 	if owned == nil {
272: 		return nil
273: 	}
274: 	owned.eventMu.Lock()
275: 	if owned.omitted > 0 {
276: 		_, _, appendErr := appendRunEventWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.EventDraft{Type: runcontrol.EventOmission, Omission: &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: "equivalent progress coalesced", Count: owned.omitted, FirstAt: &owned.omittedFirst, LastAt: &owned.omittedLast}})
277: 		if appendErr != nil && runErr == nil {
278: 			runErr = appendErr
279: 		}
280: 		owned.omitted = 0
281: 	}
282: 	owned.eventMu.Unlock()
283: 	close(owned.stop)
284: 	<-owned.done
285: 	owned.cancel()
286: 	outcome := runcontrol.TerminalSucceeded
287: 	reason := "operation completed"
288: 	switch {
289: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded):
290: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalTimedOut, "operation deadline exceeded"
291: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), state == OperationCancelled:
292: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalCancelled, "operation cancelled"
293: 	case runErr != nil, state == OperationFailed:
294: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalFailed, "operation failed"
295: 	case state == OperationPartial:
296: 		outcome, reason = runcontrol.TerminalInterrupted, "operation interrupted"
297: 	}
298: 	_, _, err := proposeRunTerminalWithRetry(ctx, m.repository, owned.fence, runcontrol.TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: reason, ProposedBy: m.owner.ID})
299: 	return err
300: }

324: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()

326: 	result := make([]activeOperationDTO, 0, h.active)
327: 	for _, record := range h.records {
328: 		if record.session != session || terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
329: 			continue
330: 		}
331: 		result = append(result, activeOperationDTO{
332: 			ID: record.doc.ID, Kind: record.doc.Kind, State: record.doc.State,
333: 			Project: record.request.Project, Sprint: record.request.Sprint, Study: record.request.Study,
334: 			StartedAt: record.doc.StartedAt,

336: 	}

338: 		left, right := result[i].StartedAt, result[j].StartedAt
339: 		if left == nil || right == nil {
340: 			return left != nil
341: 		}
342: 		return left.After(*right)

347: func (h *operationHub) cancelOperation(session, id, reason string) (operationDocument, bool, error) {
348: 	h.mu.Lock()
349: 	record := h.records[id]
350: 	if record == nil || (session != "" && record.session != session) {
351: 		h.mu.Unlock()
352: 		return operationDocument{}, false, errOperationNotFound
353: 	}
354: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
355: 		doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
356: 		h.mu.Unlock()
357: 		return doc, false, nil
358: 	}
359: 	requested := false
360: 	record.cancelOnce.Do(func() {
361: 		requested = true
362: 		record.doc.State = "cancelling"
363: 		record.doc.Reason = canonicalCancelReason(reason)
364: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "cancel_requested", map[string]any{"reason": record.doc.Reason})
365: 	})
366: 	doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
367: 	cancel := record.cancel
368: 	h.mu.Unlock()
369: 	if requested {
370: 		h.counters.cancellations.Add(1)
371: 		cancel()
372: 	}
373: 	return doc, requested, nil
374: }
375: 
376: func (h *operationHub) subscribe(session, id string, lastID uint64) ([]operationEvent, <-chan operationEvent, func(), error) {
377: 	h.mu.Lock()
378: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
379: 	h.reapLocked()
380: 	record := h.records[id]
381: 	if record == nil || record.session != session {
382: 		return nil, nil, nil, errOperationNotFound
383: 	}
384: 	if h.streams >= MaxConcurrentStreams || len(record.subscribers) >= MaxSubscribersPerOperation {
385: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
386: 		return nil, nil, nil, errSubscriberCapacity
387: 	}
388: 	if lastID > 0 && len(record.events) > 0 && lastID < record.events[0].ID-1 {
389: 		h.counters.replayGaps.Add(1)
390: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "recovery_required", map[string]any{
391: 			"oldest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.events[0].ID, 10),
392: 			"newest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.nextEventID, 10),
393: 			"refresh_path":       record.doc.DurableStatus.RefreshPath,
394: 		})
395: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
396: 	}
397: 	replay := make([]operationEvent, 0, len(record.events))
398: 	for _, event := range record.events {
399: 		if event.ID > lastID {
400: 			replay = append(replay, event)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	record.nextSubID++
404: 	sub := &operationSubscriber{id: record.nextSubID, ch: make(chan operationEvent, SubscriberQueueSize)}
405: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
406: 		close(sub.ch)
407: 	} else {
408: 		record.subscribers[sub.id] = sub
409: 		h.streams++
410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}
412: 	var once sync.Once
413: 	unsubscribe := func() {
414: 		once.Do(func() {
415: 			h.mu.Lock()
416: 			defer h.mu.Unlock()
417: 			if current, ok := record.subscribers[sub.id]; ok {
418: 				delete(record.subscribers, sub.id)
419: 				h.streams--
420: 				h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
421: 				close(current.ch)
422: 			}
423: 		})
424: 	}
425: 	return replay, sub.ch, unsubscribe, nil
426: }
427: 
428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {
429: 	name = stableOperationEventName(name)
430: 	record.nextEventID++
431: 	body := map[string]any{
432: 		"operation_id": record.doc.ID,
433: 		"time":         h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
434: 		"sequence":     record.nextEventID,
435: 		"payload":      payload,
436: 	}
437: 	data, err := json.Marshal(body)
438: 	if err != nil {
439: 		h.counters.projectionDrops.Add(1)
440: 		return
441: 	}
442: 	if len(data) > MaxEncodedEventBytes {
443: 		data, _ = json.Marshal(map[string]any{
444: 			"operation_id": record.doc.ID, "time": h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
445: 			"sequence": record.nextEventID, "payload": map[string]any{"message": "event projection exceeded the safe size limit"},
446: 		})
447: 		name = "warning"
448: 	}
449: 	event := operationEvent{ID: record.nextEventID, Name: name, Data: data}
450: 	record.events = append(record.events, event)
451: 	record.eventBytes += len(data)
452: 	for len(record.events) > MaxEventsPerOperation || record.eventBytes > MaxEventBytesPerOperation {
453: 		record.eventBytes -= len(record.events[0].Data)
454: 		record.events = record.events[1:]
455: 	}
456: 	record.doc.LastEventID = strconv.FormatUint(event.ID, 10)
457: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
458: 		select {
459: 		case subscriber.ch <- event:
460: 		default:
461: 			close(subscriber.ch)
462: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
463: 			h.streams--
464: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
465: 			h.counters.slowSubscribers.Add(1)
466: 		}
467: 	}
468: }
469: 
470: func stableOperationEventName(name string) string {
471: 	switch name {
472: 	case "snapshot", "progress", "warning", "finding", "artifact", "cancel_requested", "recovery_required", "terminal":
473: 		return name
474: 	default:
475: 		return "progress"
476: 	}
477: }
478: 
479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {
490: 		_, _, _ = h.cancelOperation("", record.doc.ID, "server_shutdown")
491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))
493: 	for _, record := range records {
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)
499: 			return errors.Join(ctx.Err(), persistErr)
500: 		}
501: 	}
502: 	return nil
503: }

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {

511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()

514: 		h.mu.Unlock()

516: 			continue
517: 		}

520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),

538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}
541: 		record.doc.State = "cleanup_uncertain"
542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}

548: 		h.counters.terminal.Add(1)

550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
551: 			close(subscriber.ch)
552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)

565: func (h *operationHub) reapLocked() {
566: 	now := h.now().UTC()

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{

581: 	}

585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),
586: 		})

591: 		}}

Key observations from web/operations.go:

1. `startConfirmed` line 180-182: `ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(h.rootCtx)` — good, rootCtx not request-scoped. AcceptOperation gets that ctx. Then if accepted.Context != nil → ctx = accepted.Context. Good.

2. **Durable accept failure with ErrWebUnavailable**: proceeds in-memory. But note: when durable accept succeeds, `id = accepted.RunID` — the record ID becomes the run ID. Then hub's `finish` calls `manager.FinishOperation(finishCtx, record.doc.ID, ...)` — uses doc.ID = RunID. OK.

3. **Hub finish mapping** (line 286-294): cancelled checked via runErr or result.State==cancelled; note DeadlineExceeded NOT mapped here (unlike FinishOperation which maps to timed_out). Hub state "failed" for deadline exceeded while durable terminal says timed_out? Wait — FinishOperation is called BEFORE h.finish: manager.FinishOperation(finishCtx, id, result.State, runErr). In FinishOperation, DeadlineExceeded→TerminalTimedOut. But does the app layer produce context.DeadlineExceeded as runErr? RunOperation with ctx deadline → services return ctx err wrapped; failedOperation maps context.Canceled only; DeadlineExceeded → failed state + error. Then FinishOperation sees errors.Is(runErr, DeadlineExceeded) → timed_out terminal in DB; hub doc says "failed". Durable vs web projection divergence: /runs/<id> shows outcome timed_out, operation doc shows failed. Is "failed" wrong? Timed out IS a failure mode; the web lifecycle vocabulary has no "timed_out" state (accepted/running/cancelling/succeeded/failed/cancelled/interrupted/cleanup_uncertain), so mapping timeout→failed at web layer and timed_out at durable layer may be intentional vocabulary narrowing. Not clearly a defect.

4. **cancelOperation session bypass**: `session != "" && record.session != session` — empty session cancels any record. Handlers must ensure non-empty for user path. Check operation_handlers.

5. **subscribe gap detection**: `lastID < record.events[0].ID-1` — if events empty (len 0) no gap detected even if lastID > 0 and nextEventID large! If all events were trimmed... trimming happens only when len>256 or bytes>cap, so events never empty after append. But a record with zero events yet and lastID=50 → replay empty, no recovery_required. Records always have snapshot event on start though. For Existing durable docs returned by startConfirmed there's no record at all. OK minor.

6. `h.dedup` check: `if record != nil && record.session == session` else delete dedup mapping. Then falls through to capacity/drain checks and starts new. Note dedup map keyed by sha256(session\0token) so session is IN the key; record.session==session redundant but fine.

7. **reapLocked deletes records after TerminalRetention (10 min)** — including deleting dedup key. So replay of same token after 10 min creates NEW run. Contract local-web.md says "Retrying the same accepted session/token returns the original operation" — presumably within retention. Fine.

8. **publishAppEvent drops event entirely on RecordOperationEvent persistence error AND cancels the record** (record.cancel()). Consistent-ish with TUI behavior (TUI drops without cancel; manager itself cancels owned op on append error inside RecordOperationEvent — yes it calls owned.cancel() internally). Fine.

9. Note `h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager)` type assertion: dashboardUseCases ALWAYS implements DurableOperationManager interface methods even when u.durable == nil (methods return ErrWebUnavailable). So assertion succeeds; AcceptOperation returns ErrWebUnavailable → proceed in-memory. finish: ErrWebUnavailable ignored. OK.

10. **`start(session, prepared)`** with empty dedupKey: production reachability? grep callers.

11. **markCleanupUncertain**: sets State cleanup_uncertain but durable row remains running/claimed until lease expiry — reconcile handles. fine.

12. drainAndWait waits `record.done` for records captured BEFORE cancelling... records list computed before cancelOperation loop; any record started between draining=true and loop? draining flag prevents new starts. Records already terminal excluded. OK. But note: cancelOperation("", ...) with session "" — works due to bypass.

13. In `run()`: `record.doc.State == "accepted"` → set running. For durable-accepted ops, initial doc.State = "accepted" set at creation; fine.

14. **Race**: publishAppEvent called from RunOperation emit callback concurrently with finish? finish holds mu; publishAppEvent checks terminal under mu then appends under same lock — atomic. After finish closes subscribers, later publish attempts appendEventLocked → sends on closed subscriber channels?? Look: appendEventLocked iterates record.subscribers — finish deleted all subscribers before closing channels... close(subscriber.ch) then delete. So map empty after finish. And publish checks terminal first → return. OK.

164: func (m Model) Update(msg Message) Model {
165: 	switch v := msg.(type) {
166: 	case LoadMsg:
167: 		m.Loading = false
168: 		if v.Err != nil {
169: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
170: 			return m
171: 		}
172: 		m.Data = v.Result
173: 		m.Runs = v.Runs
174: 		m.DurableEvents = dedupeDurableEvents(v.Events)
175: 		m.Error = ""
176: 		m.clampSelection()
177: 	case RefreshMsg:
178: 		m.Loading = false
179: 		m.Preview = nil
180: 		m.PreviewOffset = 0
181: 		if v.Err != nil {
182: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
183: 			return m
184: 		}
185: 		m.Data = v.Result
186: 		m.Runs = v.Runs
187: 		m.DurableEvents = dedupeDurableEvents(v.Events)
188: 		m.Error = ""
189: 		m.clampSelection()
190: 	case PreviewMsg:
191: 		if v.Route != (Route{}) && v.Route != m.currentRoute() {
192: 			return m
193: 		}
194: 		if v.Err != nil {
195: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
196: 			return m
197: 		}
198: 		m.Preview = &v.Result
199: 		m.PreviewTitle = v.Title
200: 		m.Error = ""
201: 		m.PreviewOffset = 0
202: 	case ValidationMsg:
203: 		m.Loading = false
204: 		if v.Route != m.currentRoute() {
205: 			return m
206: 		}
207: 		if v.Err != nil {
208: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
209: 			return m
210: 		}
211: 		m.Validation = &v.Result
212: 		m.Error = ""
213: 	case ConfirmationMsg:
214: 		m.Loading = false
215: 		if v.Route != m.currentRoute() {
216: 			return m
217: 		}
218: 		if v.Err != nil {
219: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
220: 			return m
221: 		}
222: 		m.Confirmation = &v.Result
223: 	case OperationEventMsg:
224: 		if !m.Running {
225: 			return m
226: 		}
227: 		m.Events = append(m.Events, v.Event)
228: 		if len(m.Events) > 100 {
229: 			m.Events = m.Events[len(m.Events)-100:]
230: 		}
231: 	case OperationMsg:
232: 		m.Running = false
233: 		m.Loading = false
234: 		m.Confirmation = nil
235: 		m.Operation = &v.Result
236: 		m.Events = append(m.Events, v.Events...)
237: 		if len(m.Events) > 100 {
238: 			m.Events = m.Events[len(m.Events)-100:]
239: 		}
240: 		if v.Err != nil {
241: 			m.Error = v.Err.Error()
242: 		}
243: 	case KeyMsg:
244: 		switch KeyToAction(string(v)) {
245: 		case ActionQuit:
246: 			m.Quit = true
247: 		case ActionFocusNext:
248: 			if m.ActiveTab == TabProjects {
249: 				m.setTab(TabStudies)
250: 			} else {
251: 				m.setTab(TabProjects)
252: 			}
253: 		case ActionBack:
254: 			if m.Running && !m.OperationHidden {
255: 				return m
256: 			} else if m.ParallelForm != nil {
257: 				m.ParallelForm = nil
258: 				m.ParallelValue = ""
259: 				m.ParallelError = ""
260: 			} else if m.RunViewStudy != "" {
261: 				m.RunViewStudy = ""
262: 				m.RunViewShowPrevious = false
263: 				m.Operation = nil
264: 				m.Events = nil
265: 			} else if m.Confirmation != nil {
266: 				m.Confirmation = nil
267: 			} else if m.Operation != nil && !m.OperationHidden {
268: 				m.Operation = nil
269: 				m.Events = nil
270: 				m.ActiveOperation = app.OperationRequest{}
271: 				m.OperationShowPrevious = false
272: 			} else if m.Validation != nil {
273: 				m.Validation = nil
274: 			} else if m.Preview != nil {
275: 				m.Preview = nil
276: 				m.PreviewOffset = 0
277: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent && len(m.Routes) > 1 {
278: 				m.Routes = m.Routes[:len(m.Routes)-1]
279: 				m.Selected = 0
280: 			}
281: 		case ActionUp:
282: 			if m.Preview != nil {
283: 				m.PreviewOffset--
284: 				if m.PreviewOffset < 0 {
285: 					m.PreviewOffset = 0
286: 				}
287: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent && m.Selected > 0 {
288: 				m.Selected--
289: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent && m.Selected == 0 {
290: 				m.Focus = FocusTabs
291: 			}
292: 		case ActionDown:
293: 			if m.Preview != nil {
294: 				m.PreviewOffset++
295: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
296: 				m.Focus = FocusContent
297: 			} else if m.Focus == FocusContent {
298: 				m.Selected++
299: 				m.clampSelection()
300: 			}
301: 		case ActionLeft:
302: 			if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
303: 				if m.ActiveTab == TabRuns {
304: 					m.setTab(TabStudies)
305: 				} else {
306: 					m.setTab(TabProjects)
307: 				}
308: 				m.Focus = FocusTabs
309: 			}
310: 		case ActionRight:
311: 			if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
312: 				if m.ActiveTab == TabProjects {
313: 					m.setTab(TabStudies)
314: 					m.Focus = FocusTabs
315: 				} else {
316: 					m.Focus = FocusContent
317: 				}
318: 			}
319: 		case ActionProjects:
320: 			m.setTab(TabProjects)
321: 		case ActionStudies:
322: 			m.setTab(TabStudies)
323: 		case ActionRuns:
324: 			m.setTab(TabRuns)
325: 		case ActionOpen:
326: 			if m.Preview != nil {
327: 				return m
328: 			}
329: 			if m.Focus == FocusTabs {
330: 				m.Focus = FocusContent
331: 				return m
332: 			}
333: 			if item, ok := m.selectedItem(); ok && item.Route != nil {
334: 				m.Routes = append(m.Routes, *item.Route)
335: 				m.Selected = 0
336: 			}
337: 		}
338: 	}
339: 	return m
340: }

342: func dedupeDurableEvents(events []app.RunEvent) []app.RunEvent {
343: 	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(events))
344: 	result := make([]app.RunEvent, 0, min(len(events), 200))
345: 	for _, event := range events {
346: 		key := string(event.RunID) + ":" + fmt.Sprint(event.Sequence)
347: 		if seen[key] {
348: 			continue
349: 		}
350: 		seen[key] = true
351: 		result = append(result, event)
352: 	}
353: 	if len(result) > 200 {
354: 		result = result[len(result)-200:]
355: 	}
356: 	return result
357: }

359: func (m *Model) setTab(tab Tab) {
360: 	m.ActiveTab = tab

363: 	m.Preview = nil
364: 	m.PreviewOffset = 0
365: 	if tab == TabStudies {
366: 		m.Routes = []Route{{Kind: RouteStudies}}
367: 		return
368: 	}
369: 	if tab == TabRuns {
370: 		m.Routes = []Route{{Kind: RouteRuns}}
371: 		return
372: 	}
373: 	m.Routes = []Route{{Kind: RouteProjects}}
374: }

376: func (m *Model) clampSelection() {
377: 	max := len(m.navItems()) - 1
378: 	if max < 0 {
379: 		m.Selected = 0
380: 		return
381: 	}
382: 	if m.Selected > max {
383: 		m.Selected = max
384: 	}
385: }

387: func (m Model) currentRoute() Route {
388: 	if len(m.Routes) == 0 {
389: 		if m.ActiveTab == TabStudies {
390: 			return Route{Kind: RouteStudies}
391: 		}
392: 		if m.ActiveTab == TabRuns {
393: 			return Route{Kind: RouteRuns}
394: 		}
395: 		return Route{Kind: RouteProjects}
396: 	}
397: 	return m.Routes[len(m.Routes)-1]
398: }

573: func (m Model) breadcrumb() string {
574: 	route := m.currentRoute()
575: 	switch route.Kind {
576: 	case RouteProject:
577: 		return "Projects > " + route.Project
578: 	case RouteProjectSprints:
579: 		return "Projects > " + route.Project + " > Sprints"
580: 	case RouteProjectDocs:
581: 		return "Projects > " + route.Project + " > Docs"
582: 	case RouteSprint:
583: 		return "Projects > " + route.Project + " > Sprints > " + route.Sprint

585: 		return "Projects > " + route.Project + " > Sprints > " + route.Sprint + " > QA"
586: 	case RouteSprintQAShard:

301: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, probe ProcessProbe, opts ReconcileOptions) (ReconcileReport, error) {
302: 	if probe == nil {
303: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("process_probe", "is required")
304: 	}
305: 	grace := opts.Grace
306: 	if grace == 0 {
307: 		grace = ReconciliationGrace
308: 	}
309: 	if grace < 0 {
310: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("reconciliation.grace", "must not be negative")
311: 	}
312: 	limit := opts.Limit
313: 	if limit == 0 {
314: 		limit = DefaultReconcileBatch
315: 	}
316: 	if limit < 1 || limit > MaximumReconcileBatch {
317: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("reconciliation.limit", fmt.Sprintf("must be between 1 and %d", MaximumReconcileBatch))
318: 	}
319: 	report := ReconcileReport{Decisions: make([]ReconcileDecision, 0, limit)}
320: 	acceptedPredicate, acceptedArgs := r.expiredTimestampPredicate("accepted_at", grace)
321: 	unclaimedRows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
322: SELECT run_id FROM runs
323: WHERE terminal_outcome IS NULL AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND `+acceptedPredicate+`
324: ORDER BY accepted_at ASC, run_id ASC LIMIT ?`, append(acceptedArgs, limit)...)
325: 	if err != nil {
326: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "scan unclaimed runs failed", err)
327: 	}
328: 	var unclaimed []RunID
329: 	for unclaimedRows.Next() {
330: 		var runID RunID
331: 		if err := unclaimedRows.Scan(&runID); err != nil {
332: 			unclaimedRows.Close()
333: 			return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "decode unclaimed run failed", err)
334: 		}
335: 		unclaimed = append(unclaimed, runID)
336: 	}
337: 	if err := unclaimedRows.Close(); err != nil {
338: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "close unclaimed run scan failed", err)
339: 	}
340: 	for _, runID := range unclaimed {
341: 		won, err := r.reconcileUnclaimed(ctx, runID)
342: 		if err != nil {
343: 			return report, err
344: 		}
345: 		if !won {
346: 			continue
347: 		}
348: 		report.Scanned++
349: 		report.Terminal++
350: 		decision := "owner_never_claimed_after_grace"
351: 		candidate := reconciliationCandidate{runID: runID}
352: 		_ = r.recordReconciliation(ctx, candidate, "terminal_proposal", decision)
353: 		report.Decisions = append(report.Decisions, ReconcileDecision{RunID: runID, Action: "terminal_proposal", Decision: decision})
354: 	}
355: 	remaining := limit - report.Scanned
356: 	if remaining == 0 {
357: 		r.finishReconciliationLog(ctx, &report)
358: 		return report, nil
359: 	}
360: 	predicate, predicateArgs := r.expiredLeasePredicate(grace)
361: 	queryArgs := append(predicateArgs, remaining)
362: 	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
363: SELECT runs.run_id, attempts.attempt_id, attempts.owner_id, attempts.fencing_generation,
364:        attempts.host_digest, attempts.boot_id, attempts.pid, attempts.process_birth_token
365: FROM runs JOIN attempts ON attempts.attempt_id = runs.current_attempt_id
366: WHERE runs.terminal_outcome IS NULL AND `+predicate+`
367: ORDER BY attempts.lease_expires_at ASC, runs.run_id ASC LIMIT ?`, queryArgs...)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "scan expired run owners failed", err)
370: 	}
371: 	var candidates []reconciliationCandidate
372: 	for rows.Next() {
373: 		var candidate reconciliationCandidate
374: 		if err := rows.Scan(&candidate.runID, &candidate.attemptID, &candidate.ownerID, &candidate.generation,
375: 			&candidate.process.HostDigest, &candidate.process.BootID, &candidate.process.PID, &candidate.process.BirthToken); err != nil {
376: 			rows.Close()
377: 			return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "decode expired run owner failed", err)
378: 		}
379: 		candidates = append(candidates, candidate)
380: 	}
381: 	if err := rows.Close(); err != nil {
382: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "close expired owner scan failed", err)
383: 	}
384: 	report.Scanned += len(candidates)
385: 	for _, candidate := range candidates {
386: 		observed, probeErr := probe.Probe(ctx, candidate.process.PID)
387: 		decision, outcome := reconcileProcessDecision(candidate.process, observed, probeErr)
388: 		action := "terminal_proposal"
389: 		if outcome == "" {
390: 			action = "mark_stalled"
391: 			if err := r.markStalled(ctx, candidate); err != nil {
392: 				if errors.Is(err, ErrTerminal) || errors.Is(err, ErrStaleFence) {
393: 					continue
394: 				}
395: 				return report, err
396: 			}
397: 			report.Stalled++
398: 		} else {
399: 			fence := Fence{RunID: candidate.runID, AttemptID: candidate.attemptID, OwnerID: candidate.ownerID, FencingGeneration: candidate.generation}
400: 			_, won, err := r.ProposeTerminal(ctx, fence, TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: decision, ProposedBy: "reconciler"})
401: 			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ErrTerminal) && !errors.Is(err, ErrStaleFence) {
402: 				return report, err
403: 			}
404: 			if won {
405: 				report.Terminal++
406: 				if outcome == TerminalCleanupUncertain {
407: 					report.Uncertain++
408: 				}
409: 			}
410: 		}
411: 		_ = r.recordReconciliation(ctx, candidate, action, decision)
412: 		report.Decisions = append(report.Decisions, ReconcileDecision{RunID: candidate.runID, AttemptID: candidate.attemptID, Action: action, Decision: decision})
413: 	}
414: 	r.finishReconciliationLog(ctx, &report)
415: 	return report, nil
416: }

428: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
429: 	defer func() { r.metrics.terminal.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
430: 	now := r.now()
431: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
432: 	if err != nil {
433: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_begin", "begin unclaimed reconciliation failed", err)
434: 	}

436: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, runID)
437: 	if err != nil {
438: 		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
439: 			return false, nil
440: 		}
441: 		return false, err
442: 	}
443: 	if current.Terminal != nil || current.CurrentAttemptID != "" {
444: 		return false, nil
445: 	}
446: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
447: 	reason := "owner_never_claimed_after_grace"
448: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"outcome": string(TerminalInterrupted), "reason": reason}, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)

452: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, payload_json)
453: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'terminal', ?)`, string(runID), sequence, formatTime(now), payload); err != nil {
454: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_event", "persist unclaimed terminal event failed", err)
455: 	}
456: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE runs SET lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, finished_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?,
457: terminal_outcome = ?, terminal_reason = ?, terminal_at = ?, terminal_proposed_by = 'reconciler'
458: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
459: 		string(LifecycleInterrupted), string(LivenessTerminal), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence,
460: 		string(TerminalInterrupted), reason, formatTime(now), string(runID))

462: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_cas", "persist unclaimed terminal state failed", err)

469: 		return false, nil
470: 	}
471: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
472: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_commit", "commit unclaimed reconciliation failed", err)

475: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "unclaimed run reconciled",
476: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(runID)}, LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: fmt.Sprint(sequence)},
477: 		LogField{Key: "terminal_outcome", Value: string(TerminalInterrupted)})

481: func reconcileProcessDecision(expected, observed ProcessIdentity, probeErr error) (string, TerminalOutcome) {
482: 	if errors.Is(probeErr, ErrProcessNotFound) {
483: 		return "owner_process_missing_after_grace", TerminalInterrupted

492: 		return "owner_process_birth_mismatch_after_grace", TerminalInterrupted
493: 	}

137: 	if ctx == nil {
138: 		ctx = context.Background()
139: 	}
140: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
141: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
142: 	}
143: 	now := r.now()
144: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
145: 	if err != nil {
146: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_begin", "begin cancellation acknowledgement failed", err)
147: 	}
148: 	defer tx.Rollback()
149: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
150: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
151: 	}
152: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
153: 	if err != nil {
154: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
155: 	}
156: 	if current.Terminal != nil || current.Cancellation.State == CancellationAcknowledged {
157: 		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
158: 			return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_read_commit", "finish cancellation acknowledgement read failed", err)
159: 		}
160: 		return current, false, nil
161: 	}
162: 	if current.Cancellation.State != CancellationRequested {
163: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeConflict, "cancel_ack", fence.RunID, "cancellation has not been requested", false, nil)
164: 	}
165: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
166: 	payload, _ := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"state": string(CancellationAcknowledged)}, MaxSafeValueBytes)
167: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, payload_json)
168: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'cancellation', ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(fence.AttemptID), payload); err != nil {
169: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_event", "persist cancellation acknowledgement event failed", err)
170: 	}
171: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
172: UPDATE runs SET cancellation_state = ?, cancellation_acknowledged_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?
173: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND cancellation_state = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL AND last_sequence = ?`,
174: 		string(CancellationAcknowledged), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence, string(fence.RunID), string(fence.AttemptID),
175: 		string(CancellationRequested), current.LastSequence)
176: 	if err != nil {
177: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack", "persist cancellation acknowledgement failed", err)
178: 	}
179: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
180: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeStaleFence, "cancel_ack", fence.RunID, "cancellation acknowledgement lost its fence", false, err)
181: 	}
182: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
183: 	if err != nil {
184: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
185: 	}
186: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
187: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("cancel_ack_commit", "commit cancellation acknowledgement failed", err)
188: 	}
189: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
190: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run cancellation acknowledged",
191: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
192: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: fmt.Sprint(sequence)}, LogField{Key: "cancellation_state", Value: string(snapshot.Cancellation.State)})
193: 	return snapshot, true, nil
194: }

301: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Reconcile(ctx context.Context, probe ProcessProbe, opts ReconcileOptions) (ReconcileReport, error) {
302: 	if probe == nil {
303: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("process_probe", "is required")
304: 	}
305: 	grace := opts.Grace
306: 	if grace == 0 {
307: 		grace = ReconciliationGrace
308: 	}
309: 	if grace < 0 {
310: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("reconciliation.grace", "must not be negative")
311: 	}
312: 	limit := opts.Limit
313: 	if limit == 0 {
314: 		limit = DefaultReconcileBatch
315: 	}
316: 	if limit < 1 || limit > MaximumReconcileBatch {
317: 		return ReconcileReport{}, invalidField("reconciliation.limit", fmt.Sprintf("must be between 1 and %d", MaximumReconcileBatch))
318: 	}
319: 	report := ReconcileReport{Decisions: make([]ReconcileDecision, 0, limit)}
320: 	acceptedPredicate, acceptedArgs := r.expiredTimestampPredicate("accepted_at", grace)
321: 	unclaimedRows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
322: SELECT run_id FROM runs
323: WHERE terminal_outcome IS NULL AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND `+acceptedPredicate+`
324: ORDER BY accepted_at ASC, run_id ASC LIMIT ?`, append(acceptedArgs, limit)...)
325: 	if err != nil {
326: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "scan unclaimed runs failed", err)
327: 	}
328: 	var unclaimed []RunID
329: 	for unclaimedRows.Next() {
330: 		var runID RunID
331: 		if err := unclaimedRows.Scan(&runID); err != nil {
332: 			unclaimedRows.Close()
333: 			return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "decode unclaimed run failed", err)
334: 		}
335: 		unclaimed = append(unclaimed, runID)
336: 	}
337: 	if err := unclaimedRows.Close(); err != nil {
338: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "close unclaimed run scan failed", err)
339: 	}
340: 	for _, runID := range unclaimed {
341: 		won, err := r.reconcileUnclaimed(ctx, runID)
342: 		if err != nil {
343: 			return report, err
344: 		}
345: 		if !won {
346: 			continue
347: 		}
348: 		report.Scanned++
349: 		report.Terminal++
350: 		decision := "owner_never_claimed_after_grace"
351: 		candidate := reconciliationCandidate{runID: runID}
352: 		_ = r.recordReconciliation(ctx, candidate, "terminal_proposal", decision)
353: 		report.Decisions = append(report.Decisions, ReconcileDecision{RunID: runID, Action: "terminal_proposal", Decision: decision})
354: 	}
355: 	remaining := limit - report.Scanned
356: 	if remaining == 0 {
357: 		r.finishReconciliationLog(ctx, &report)
358: 		return report, nil
359: 	}
360: 	predicate, predicateArgs := r.expiredLeasePredicate(grace)
361: 	queryArgs := append(predicateArgs, remaining)
362: 	rows, err := r.db.QueryContext(ctx, `
363: SELECT runs.run_id, attempts.attempt_id, attempts.owner_id, attempts.fencing_generation,
364:        attempts.host_digest, attempts.boot_id, attempts.pid, attempts.process_birth_token
365: FROM runs JOIN attempts ON attempts.attempt_id = runs.current_attempt_id
366: WHERE runs.terminal_outcome IS NULL AND `+predicate+`
367: ORDER BY attempts.lease_expires_at ASC, runs.run_id ASC LIMIT ?`, queryArgs...)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "scan expired run owners failed", err)
370: 	}
371: 	var candidates []reconciliationCandidate
372: 	for rows.Next() {
373: 		var candidate reconciliationCandidate
374: 		if err := rows.Scan(&candidate.runID, &candidate.attemptID, &candidate.ownerID, &candidate.generation,
375: 			&candidate.process.HostDigest, &candidate.process.BootID, &candidate.process.PID, &candidate.process.BirthToken); err != nil {
376: 			rows.Close()
377: 			return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "decode expired run owner failed", err)
378: 		}
379: 		candidates = append(candidates, candidate)
380: 	}
381: 	if err := rows.Close(); err != nil {
382: 		return ReconcileReport{}, classifyStoreError("reconcile_scan", "close expired owner scan failed", err)
383: 	}
384: 	report.Scanned += len(candidates)
385: 	for _, candidate := range candidates {
386: 		observed, probeErr := probe.Probe(ctx, candidate.process.PID)
387: 		decision, outcome := reconcileProcessDecision(candidate.process, observed, probeErr)
388: 		action := "terminal_proposal"
389: 		if outcome == "" {
390: 			action = "mark_stalled"
391: 			if err := r.markStalled(ctx, candidate); err != nil {
392: 				if errors.Is(err, ErrTerminal) || errors.Is(err, ErrStaleFence) {
393: 					continue
394: 				}
395: 				return report, err
396: 			}
397: 			report.Stalled++
398: 		} else {
399: 			fence := Fence{RunID: candidate.runID, AttemptID: candidate.attemptID, OwnerID: candidate.ownerID, FencingGeneration: candidate.generation}
400: 			_, won, err := r.ProposeTerminal(ctx, fence, TerminalProposal{Outcome: outcome, Reason: decision, ProposedBy: "reconciler"})
401: 			if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, ErrTerminal) && !errors.Is(err, ErrStaleFence) {
402: 				return report, err
403: 			}
404: 			if won {
405: 				report.Terminal++
406: 				if outcome == TerminalCleanupUncertain {
407: 					report.Uncertain++
408: 				}
409: 			}
410: 		}
411: 		_ = r.recordReconciliation(ctx, candidate, action, decision)
412: 		report.Decisions = append(report.Decisions, ReconcileDecision{RunID: candidate.runID, AttemptID: candidate.attemptID, Action: action, Decision: decision})
413: 	}
414: 	r.finishReconciliationLog(ctx, &report)
415: 	return report, nil
416: }

428: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
429: 	defer func() { r.metrics.terminal.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
430: 	now := r.now()
431: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
432: 	if err != nil {
433: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_begin", "begin unclaimed reconciliation failed", err)
434: 	}
435: 	defer tx.Rollback()
436: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, runID)
437: 	if err != nil {
438: 		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
439: 			return false, nil
440: 		}
441: 		return false, err
442: 	}
443: 	if current.Terminal != nil || current.CurrentAttemptID != "" {
444: 		return false, nil
445: 	}
446: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
447: 	reason := "owner_never_claimed_after_grace"
448: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"outcome": string(TerminalInterrupted), "reason": reason}, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
449: 	if err != nil {
450: 		return false, err
451: 	}
452: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, payload_json)
453: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'terminal', ?)`, string(runID), sequence, formatTime(now), payload); err != nil {
454: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_event", "persist unclaimed terminal event failed", err)
455: 	}
456: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE runs SET lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, finished_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?,
457: terminal_outcome = ?, terminal_reason = ?, terminal_at = ?, terminal_proposed_by = 'reconciler'
458: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id IS NULL AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
459: 		string(LifecycleInterrupted), string(LivenessTerminal), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence,
460: 		string(TerminalInterrupted), reason, formatTime(now), string(runID))
461: 	if err != nil {
462: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_cas", "persist unclaimed terminal state failed", err)
463: 	}
464: 	changed, err := result.RowsAffected()
465: 	if err != nil {
466: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_cas", "inspect unclaimed terminal state failed", err)
467: 	}
468: 	if changed != 1 {
469: 		return false, nil
470: 	}
471: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
472: 		return false, classifyStoreError("reconcile_unclaimed_commit", "commit unclaimed reconciliation failed", err)
473: 	}

475: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "unclaimed run reconciled",
476: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(runID)}, LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: fmt.Sprint(sequence)},
477: 		LogField{Key: "terminal_outcome", Value: string(TerminalInterrupted)})

481: func reconcileProcessDecision(expected, observed ProcessIdentity, probeErr error) (string, TerminalOutcome) {
482: 	if errors.Is(probeErr, ErrProcessNotFound) {
483: 		return "owner_process_missing_after_grace", TerminalInterrupted
484: 	}
485: 	if probeErr != nil {
486: 		return "owner_process_identity_uncertain_after_grace", TerminalCleanupUncertain
487: 	}
488: 	if expected.HostDigest == "" || expected.BootID == "" || expected.BirthToken == "" || observed.HostDigest == "" || observed.BootID == "" || observed.BirthToken == "" {
489: 		return "owner_process_identity_incomplete_after_grace", TerminalCleanupUncertain
490: 	}
491: 	if expected.HostDigest != observed.HostDigest || expected.BootID != observed.BootID || expected.PID != observed.PID || expected.BirthToken != observed.BirthToken {
492: 		return "owner_process_birth_mismatch_after_grace", TerminalInterrupted
493: 	}
494: 	return "exact_owner_process_still_live_but_lease_expired", ""
495: }

ResolveOperationAlias returns the snapshot regardless of terminal state; AcceptOperation returns Existing=true with Lifecycle=whatever ("succeeded"/"failed"). TUI shows "matching durable operation already exists". Yes.

But hold on — is there counter-evidence? Maybe the TUI confirmation flow includes something that changes between prepares... The canonical request includes ExpectedFingerprint cleared, but InputFingerprint is part of digest basis. For smoke-start: governed inputs = base project/sprint files. After a smoke run, smoke.md written (not hashed), flow-state.json updated? RunSmoke writes smoke.md and flow-state update per prepare scope text ("one smoke.md and flow-state update" — that's QA smoke suite). SmokeStart scope: "SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE". flow-state.json not in hash list. requirements.md etc. unchanged. So yes identical digest.

Hmm wait, one more consideration: does the sprint smoke layer REFUSE to re-run smoke when fresh? If smoke.md is fresh, maybe re-running is rejected by product logic anyway ("smoke already fresh")? There's ForceReview/OverrideRationale for review override. Not sure about smoke freshness rejection. Even so, the TUI failure mode occurs BEFORE reaching product logic — the user gets "matching durable operation already exists" instead of either the run or the product-level refusal. And for execute-start after transient failure: execute resume kind exists, fine. But consider OperationQAStart with shard Task: .run-state.json hashed → changes. OK.

Actually, wait. I should also check the WEB door more carefully for the same logical action: each web prepare creates a new token → new dedup key → repeat allowed. So cross-door: web allows repeat of identical smoke-start, TUI forbids. That's the parity violation the assignment frames ("same logical action arriving via different doors must produce equivalent durable semantics").

Now, is this TUI behavior possibly intended as "content-addressed idempotency"? The context pack notes it descriptively. The contract docs (user-guide) say nothing about TUI dedup semantics AFAICT. local-web.md documents web replay only. So TUI's permanent content-dedup is undocumented and divergent. 387: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Unavailable", "The operation capability is unavailable.")
388: 		return
389: 	}
390: 	doc, requested, err := h.hub.cancelOperation(sessionID(r.Context()), id, "user_request")
391: 	if err != nil && h.runs != nil {
392: 		snapshot, changed, cancelErr := h.runs.CancelRun(r.Context(), app.RunID(id), "user_requested")
393: 		if cancelErr == nil && string(snapshot.RunID) == id {
394: 			doc, requested, err = durableOperationDocument(snapshot), changed, nil
395: 		}
396: 	}
397: 	if err != nil {
398: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
399: 			h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "Legacy operation not retained", "This pre-durable operation expired. Refresh the owning product or open the workspace run list.")
400: 			return
401: 		}
402: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusNotFound, "Operation not retained", "Refresh the owning project, sprint, or study page for durable status.")
403: 		return
404: 	}
405: 	if requested {
406: 		h.logOperation(r, "operation_cancel_requested", doc.ID, string(doc.Kind), doc.State, doc.Reason)
407: 	}
408: 	http.Redirect(w, r, "/operations/"+doc.ID, http.StatusSeeOther)
409: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

556: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
557: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
558: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
559: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
560: 		return ""
561: 	}
562: 	for _, r := range number {
563: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
564: 			return number + "-" + name
565: 		}
566: 	}
567: 	var slug strings.Builder
568: 	separator := false
569: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
570: 		switch {
571: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
572: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
573: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
574: 			}
575: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
576: 			separator = false
577: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
578: 			separator = true
579: 		default:
580: 			return number + "-" + name
581: 		}
582: 	}
583: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
584: 		return ""
585: 	}
586: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
587: }

594: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
595: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
596: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
597: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
598: 	}
599: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
600: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
601: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
602: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
603: 	}
604: 	var extra any
605: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
606: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
607: 	}
608: 	return nil
609: }
